---
title: FRS Restriction
---

@vemuriOsteopathicManipulativeTreatment2026

This is shorthand for a non-neutral dysfunction.
This is non-neutral because flexion or extension impact the dysfunction.

FRS stands for "flexion-rotation-sidebend".
ERS stands for extension-rotation-sidebend.

There is a positional and motion restriction.


Diagnosed by positional restriction.


# Examples
## ERS-Right

Case example: 

- Positional Diagnosis: ERS-Right
- Motion restriction: FRS-Left

| | Left | Right |
|-|-|-|
|Facet opening| Normal | Abnormal |
|Sidebending| Restricted | Normal |
